subject.title: [Bug]: 6.x state migration leaves channel conversation-store SQLite empty (0 bytes) — orphans references, breaks proactive (Bot Framework) sends (MS Teams)

question: Should maintainers accept the open MS Teams migration guard as the fix for this issue, or require broader recovery or packaged-upgrade proof first?
rationale: The linked fix changes persisted-state migration archive behavior for existing users, and maintainers need to decide whether the narrow guard is enough before the issue can close.

options.title: Review The Linked Fix
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98862 as the canonical fix path and close this issue only after that PR or an equivalent patch lands.

options.title: Require Upgrade Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted 2026.5.x or 2026.6.x to patched upgrade or doctor transcript before accepting the migration behavior change.

options.title: Expand Recovery Scope
options.body: Hold the linked PR if maintainers want the same fix to recover already archived legacy sources or partial imports.

recommendation.title: Review The Linked Fix
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98862 as the canonical fix path and close this issue only after that PR or an equivalent patch lands.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the most relevant MS Teams SQLite migration history and is best positioned to decide the upgrade-safety scope.
